title: Chapter 32
text: Author’s Note Thank you all so much for reading Ensnared ! We can’t tell you how much it means to us that you trusted us with our spider alien romance. This is a project that we’ve wanted to do for a couple years now, and last year we finally just said, ‘Let’s do this!’. We contacted Sam about the covers, she helped us with the concept art for our spider hero (we wanted spider, but we wanted sexy too!), and everything took off from there. She’s truly amazing. You’re probably yelling at us right now after that cliffhanger, right? Sorry! (Or is it, sorrynotsorry? LOL!) We wanted to take our time to tell this story and knew it was going to be long, too long to fit into a single novel, so we chose to make The Spider’s Mate a trilogy. We plan to finish the trilogy before we touch anything else, so no worries about waiting too long. Enthralled , the second book, will be coming soon! It’s already up for pre-order. We’d also love it if you could spare a moment to leave a review for Ensnared . And if you really loved this book, please consider recommending it in your favorite book groups. Word of mouth is one of the most helpful things for an author. Also, come join our Facebook Reader Group, Tiffany Roberts’ Ravagers ! We share a lot of extra goodies there, including the concept art that I mentioned above and much more. Thanks again! Turn the page for the blurb and cover of Enthralled (The Spider’s Mate #2).
